author: mustafa
body:
Gummi3

So I have 2 infractions warns that I believe should be appealed. I wanted to get them both done together if that is possible :)

Here is the first one...
https://gyazo.com/ef6d9c8f3b3f637d00e4eaf46f170a8d
Here's the story... My team was scrimming with Apollo and all of a sudden I got kicked. When I logged back on I asked Eric why he kicked me and he said that his team said I was block glitching. First off, I was never block glitching. Second, Eric did not even see it himself and he kicked me. If you would like you can contact him but I never was block glitching and he kicked me on behalf of his team. 

Here is the second one... (I don't know if this one will count though)
https://gyazo.com/1ebe51c07a20f16195e1117c5366fc96
So I got warned for spamming and I was told that you are allowed to spam on a scrim server. I am not sure if that is allowed now but I'm pretty sure when I got the infraction it was allowed. Also, the server was hosted by us. I don't believe that this is a valid reason for a warn but I am not sure. 
Thanks for reading!

replies.body:
Hey Gummi,

Unfortunately, I cannot appeal your first infraction because there is nothing to support the fact that you weren't block glitching. However, I will appeal your second infraction because spamming is allowed on scrim servers.

Regards,
PeachyYas | Senior Moderator
